lines.beaver_en: Hello. How can I help you?
lines.learner: 공공 시설 사용 허가를 받고 싶어요.
lines.en: I'd like to get permission to use a public facility.
lines.roman: gonggong siseol sayong heogareul batgo sipeoyo.

lines.en: The square in front of the national park in Yangpyeong County.

lines.beaver_en: Did you bring your group registration certificate?

lines.en: When does the committee do the review?

lines.learner: 오후 몇 시에 시작해요? 두 시예요?
lines.en: What time in the afternoon does it start? Two o'clock?
lines.roman: ohu myeot sie sijakaeyo? du siyeyo?

lines.beaver: 세 시 반이에요. 규정도 이달부터 바뀌었어요.
lines.beaver_en: It's at 3:30. The rules also changed this month.
lines.beaver_roman: se si banieyo. gyujeongdo idalbuteo bakkwieosseoyo.
lines.en: From what date did the new rules take effect?

lines.beaver: 이달 1일부터요. 행정 확인서가 하나 더 필요해요.
lines.beaver_en: From the 1st of this month. You need one more administrative form.
lines.beaver_roman: idal irilbuteoyo. haengjeong hwaginseoga hana deo piryohaeyo.
lines.en: Where do I get that form?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, you can get it at the county office's administration section.
lines.en: Until what time is the administration section open?

lines.beaver: 네 시까지예요. 지금 세 시 이십 분이에요.
lines.beaver_roman: ne sikkajiyeyo. jigeum se si isip bunieyo.
lines.learner: 그럼 사십 분 남았네요. 지금 갈게요.
lines.en: Then I have forty minutes. I'll go now.
lines.roman: geureom sasip bun namanneyo. jigeum galgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Okay, please submit the documents by Friday.
lines.learner: 알겠어요. 금요일 오전 열 시에 올게요.
lines.en: Got it. I'll come Friday at 10 a.m.
lines.roman: algesseoyo. geumyoil ojeon yeol sie olgeyo.
